questions.question: Explain why a frame made of triangles is stronger than a frame made of squares.
questions.expected_answer: A square frame can be pushed out of shape into a diamond, because its corners can change their angles without any strut changing length. A triangle cannot change shape unless one of its sides changes length, and struts do not stretch or shrink, so a frame of triangles keeps its shape.

questions.question: How can you make a wobbly square frame strong?
questions.expected_answer: Add a diagonal strut, or brace, from one corner to the opposite corner. This divides the square into two triangles, so it can no longer change shape.

questions.question: Name four structures that use triangles in their frames.
questions.expected_answer: Any four, for example roof trusses, bridges, tower cranes, electricity pylons, cell phone towers or scaffolding.
